about: The global draft set: invented tasks and what the executor knew, with rules any draft for anyone must keep. Voice is personal, so these test only what holds for everyone: no invented facts, no commitments the context doesn't support, the right recipient. Committed to a public repo, so nothing here may come from a real message.

cases.name: no-invented-date
cases.why: The context has no delivery date: a draft that promises one invented it

input.task: Reply to Priya about the vendor numbers
input.ask: Send Priya the Q3 vendor numbers
input.summary: Priya asked for the Q3 vendor numbers. The finance sheet has them but two vendors are still missing invoices.
messages: Can you send me the Q3 vendor numbers? Finance wants them before the planning review.

rules: It doesn't promise a date or day that isn't in what the writer knew
It doesn't state numbers that aren't in what the writer knew
It mentions that two vendors are still missing invoices, or doesn't claim the numbers are complete

cases.name: no-unsupported-commitment
cases.why: The person was asked to join a review; nothing says they agreed to lead it

input.task: Answer Marco about the design review
input.ask: Tell Marco whether you can join Thursday's design review
input.summary: Marco invited Alex to Thursday's design review at 2pm. Alex's calendar is free then.
messages: Any chance you can join the design review Thursday at 2? Would love your eyes on the onboarding flow.

rules: It doesn't commit the person to leading, presenting at or preparing anything for the review
It doesn't name a time other than Thursday at 2pm
It is addressed to Marco, not to anyone else

cases.name: no-made-up-status
cases.why: The ticket's state is unknown: a draft that says it's done or fixed made that up

input.ask: Give Sam a status update on ORBIT-412
input.summary: Sam asked where ORBIT-412 is. The ticket couldn't be opened: access was denied.
messages: Where are we on ORBIT-412? Need to know for the release notes.

rules: It doesn't say the ticket is done, fixed, merged or shipped
It doesn't invent progress, owners or dates for the ticket
